All 12 checks pass. Here's a summary of what was built:

---

**`index.html`** — the main file, with `styles.css` and `main.js` alongside it.

### Sections
| Section | Details |
|---|---|
| **Announcement bar** | Promotional strip with sale link |
| **Header / Nav** | Sticky nav, mobile hamburger, search & cart buttons |
| **Hero** | Full-bleed image, italic headline, CTA buttons, stat counters |
| **Category strip** | 8 icon-based category cards |
| **Featured Products** | 8-product grid with badges (New/Sale/Limited), ratings, quick-add |
| **Deals** | Countdown timer on main deal, 2 secondary deal cards |
| **Trust strip** | Free shipping, returns, security, sustainability |
| **Editorial / Journal** | 3 story cards with author avatars and tags |
| **Newsletter** | Email subscribe form |
| **Footer** | 4-column layout, social links, legal |

### Interactions (vanilla JS)
- **Cart drawer** — add/remove/quantity, persisted to `localStorage`, live badge count
- **Search modal** — keyboard-accessible with popular search tags
- **Countdown timer** — live ticking deal timer
- **Toast notifications** — "added to cart" feedback
- **Scroll reveal** — `IntersectionObserver` fade-in animations
- **Focus management** — trap, skip link, `Escape` to close modals
- **Reduced motion** — respects `prefers-reduced-motion`
